style: Detailed ligne claire comic illustration, like a Tintin album page, for a cozy language-learning mystery game: clean medium-weight ink-navy linework, flat colours, natural proportions and simple expressive faces, and a high level of loving detail everywhere — fully furnished environments, patterned wallpaper, parquet floorboards, fabric texture lines such as corduroy ridges, small everyday props. Limited warm palette: ink-navy (#1f3a5f), terracotta (#c9683b), mustard (#d9a441), sage (#7a9a7e), soft blue and cream. Dramatic but readable lighting chosen per scene (default: a warm shaft of light from a door or window cutting into cool blue-grey half-light, dust motes); all detail stays visible in the shadow areas. Characters have bare hands, no gloves. No text, no letters, no numbers anywhere in the image, no watermark.

blocks.maya: Maya Ellison, a woman in her mid-twenties, podcaster and amateur detective, drawn with natural adult proportions and a realistic head-to-body ratio, a friendly youthful face with gentle features, normal-sized eyes, light delicate linework — never chibi, never a cute big-headed cartoon. Shoulder-length dark brown curly hair, round amber-coloured glasses, mustard-yellow corduroy jacket over a cream-and-navy striped shirt, dark trousers, white sneakers, a sage-green canvas messenger bag worn across the body. Warm medium skin tone, curious and slightly dramatic expression.
blocks.jonas: Jonas, a man around thirty, tall and lanky, drawn with natural adult proportions and a realistic head-to-body ratio, never chibi. Short blond hair, round wire glasses, forest-green hoodie over a white t-shirt, blue jeans, brown leather sneakers. Light skin, friendly and a little shy expression.
blocks.lena: Lena, a woman around thirty, drawn with natural adult proportions and a realistic head-to-body ratio, never chibi. Straight black hair in a low bun, light olive skin, a terracotta-red wool coat over a cream blouse, a soft blue scarf, dark trousers, small gold earrings, ankle boots. Composed, hard-to-read expression.
blocks.boehm: Herr Böhm, the building caretaker, a heavyset man in his sixties, drawn with natural adult proportions and a realistic head-to-body ratio, never chibi. Grey moustache, bushy grey eyebrows, flat tweed cap, navy work overalls over a red-and-grey checked shirt, black work boots, a large ring of keys on his belt. Ruddy light skin, permanently unimpressed expression.
blocks.room: A Berlin Altbau shared-flat bedroom with a high ceiling, sage-green walls, a tall window and warm wooden floorboards, stripped almost bare: an empty bed frame, an ink-navy wardrobe with one door open and empty hangers, pale rectangles on the wall where posters used to be, a torn piece of paper on the floorboards.
blocks.pension: A small old-fashioned Berlin guesthouse lobby: a dark wooden reception desk with a brass bell and an old black telephone, a wall of brass keys on numbered-free blank hooks behind it, a worn green armchair, a potted fern, warm lamp light.
blocks.passantin: A woman in her fifties, drawn with natural adult proportions and a realistic head-to-body ratio, never chibi. Short grey bob haircut, red-framed glasses, a sage-green rain jacket, navy trousers, sturdy brown shoes, a mustard-yellow canvas tote bag over one shoulder, walking a small brown dachshund on a red lead. Light skin, brisk and kind expression, always in a hurry.
blocks.baeckerin: Frau Demir, a baker in her forties, drawn with natural adult proportions and a realistic head-to-body ratio, never chibi. Round friendly face, dark curly hair tied up under a cream headscarf, sleeves rolled up, a terracotta-red apron dusted with flour over a cream shirt. Medium-brown skin, warm and chatty expression.
blocks.baeckerei: A small cosy Berlin corner bakery: a warm wooden counter with a curved glass display case, wooden shelves of bread loaves behind, a chrome coffee machine, a blank black chalkboard on the wall, terracotta floor tiles, a window onto the street. The shop front and walls carry no lettering at all.
blocks.square: A small Berlin neighbourhood square: a navy U-Bahn entrance with railings and a blank square sign, a large blank city-map board on two posts, cobblestones, linden trees, a pedestrian crossing with a traffic light, a corner bakery with a terracotta-and-cream striped awning that carries no lettering, rows of pastel Altbau houses with balconies.
blocks.altbau_door: The entrance of a Berlin Altbau apartment building: a tall dark-green wooden double door with carved panels, a brass doorbell panel with four blank brass name plates mounted on the wall beside the door, patterned tiles on the step, a pale yellow plaster facade.
blocks.suitcase: her large ink-navy hard-shell wheeled suitcase with a telescopic handle (always this one: never brown, never leather, no stickers)
blocks.oma: Frau Hartmann, the guesthouse owner, a small upright woman around eighty, drawn with natural adult proportions and a realistic head-to-body ratio, never chibi. White hair pinned up, half-moon reading glasses on a thin chain, a sage-green cardigan over a cream blouse with a small gold brooch, a dark skirt, sensible brown shoes. Light skin with fine lines, sharp eyes, dry amused expression.
blocks.kurier: A parcel courier, a young person in a yellow rain jacket, black cycling helmet, dark trousers, a parcel scanner in one hand, in a hurry, friendly but bored.
blocks.breakfast_room: The breakfast room of a small old Berlin guesthouse: sunlit, three small tables with white tablecloths and cane chairs, a dark wooden dresser with cups and a coffee pot, a tall wall clock, a wall of framed black-and-white photographs of an old house, striped cream-and-sage wallpaper, parquet floor.
blocks.pension_kitchen: An old Berlin guesthouse kitchen: cream and sage wall tiles, a big enamel gas stove, copper pots on hooks, a long wooden work table in the foreground, a window with a lace curtain, a cast-iron pan, a wooden spoon rack.
blocks.hinterhof: A Berlin Hinterhof, the inner courtyard of an old tenement: tall brick and plaster walls on all sides with rows of windows, a dark green painted back door with a coir doormat in front of it, a terracotta flower pot beside the door, a low window with a wide stone windowsill next to the door, bicycle racks, a row of bins, a single tree, cobblestones.
blocks.studio: A small guesthouse room being turned into a tiny podcast studio: one wall freshly painted light blue and still half done with a paint roller tray on the floor, a wooden desk with a large podcast microphone on an arm, a pair of headphones, a standing lamp, a wooden crate, foam panels leaning on the wall, a long blank cloth banner hung across the top of the wall.
